addLabel.description:
Label for the add-row action. Give it concrete wording when more than
one editor is on the page. Defaults to `'Add pair'`.

label.description:
Visible name for the whole list, shown above the rows ("Environment"). The editor becomes a
labelled group, so a screen reader announces it when focus enters the list.

description.description:
Help under the Add button, linked to the group with `aria-describedby`. State what the values
are, such as that they are masked and never shown again.

keyLabel.description:
Accessible name of every row's key input (it has no visible label of its own). Give it the
noun the rows use, such as `'Name'` for environment variables.

valueLabel.description: Accessible name of every row's value input.

monospace.description:
Draws the key and value inputs in the monospace face, for identifiers and secrets such as
environment variable names.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

unsupportedProps.name: entries
unsupportedProps.description:
The editable list of key/value rows. Bindable. Defaults to `[]`.
(`KeyValueEntry` is not expressible in JSON Schema, so this default
only appears here in prose.)

unsupportedProps.name: onValueChange
unsupportedProps.description: Callback form of the resulting array, for when the parent does not use `bind:entries`.

unsupportedProps.name: removeLabel
unsupportedProps.description:
Label for a row's remove action, given that row's key. Give it concrete
wording when more than one editor is on the page. Defaults to
`` (key) => `Remove ${key || 'pair'}` ``—an empty key (a newly added,
not-yet-named row) falls back to `'Remove pair'`.

unsupportedProps.name: secret
unsupportedProps.description: Predicate receiving a row's key; routes that row's value through a password input when it returns `true`.
